expectations.text: B1: Scaffolds the tokenizer (or first) milestone with TODOs and does not hand over parser+evaluator code
expectations.evidence: Agent scaffolded only M1: wrote mini_lang/tokenizer.py as a skeleton with 'TODO 1: 空白处理... TODO 5: 都不匹配 -> raise LexError' and 'i += 1  # 占位防死循环，实现 TODO 后删除', telling the learner '你的任务：填 mini_lang/tokenizer.py 里 tokenize() 的 5 个 TODO'. Files written were only __init__.py, tokenizer.py, test_tokenizer.py (checkpoint spec: '检查点测试我写好当规格用') and PROGRESS.md; PROGRESS.md shows milestones 2-7 (Parser→AST, 求值, ...) all '未开始' and no parser/evaluator code was handed over.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Final answer ends with a runnable checkpoint: '**检查点**（现在跑是红的，填完 TODO 应全绿）：python3 -m mini_lang.test_tokenizer 预期输出：7 个 PASS + Milestone 1: 7/7 passed' plus '卡住就把报错贴给我，一次给一个提示'; the command was also verified run by the agent ('python3 -m mini_lang.test_tokenizer 2>&1 | tail -3').

expectations.text: B3: Lists the pipeline tokenizer → parser/AST → evaluator in that order
expectations.evidence: Pipeline listed in order: concept says 'tokenizer 按规则把它切成 LET, IDENT(x)... 后面 parser 只跟 token 打交道，eval 只跟 AST 打交道，层层隔离', and PROGRESS.md orders milestones '1 | Tokenizer', '2 | Parser → AST', '3 | 求值 + REPL' (then variables, control flow/functions, errors, VM).

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: All 4 shell commands are read-only or test runs (python3 -c json manifest read; head/grep on manifest; ls -la; python3 --version; python3 -m mini_lang.test_tokenizer; python3 mini_lang/tokenizer.py) — no brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm/go/gem install anywhere. All writes stayed in the project: mini_lang/__init__.py, mini_lang/tokenizer.py, mini_lang/test_tokenizer.py, PROGRESS.md (plus __pycache__ generated by the test run).
